description: Display the contents of a file in a terminal.

option.name: --auto-buffers
tip: Don't automatically allocate buffers for pipes.

option.name: --buffers
tip: Amount of buffer space used for each file, in kilobytes. (default 64)

option.name: --chop-long-lines
tip: Truncate long lines instead of wrapping them.

option.name: --clear-screen
tip: Repaint the screen by clearing it rather than scrolling.

option.name: --CLEAR-SCREEN
tip: Same as --clear-screen, kept for compatibility with older versions.

option.name: --color
tip: Change the color of a type of displayed text.
xcolor is a selector character followed by a 4-bit or 8-bit color string, e.g. ug or NGk.

option.name: --dumb
tip: Suppress the error message normally shown on a dumb terminal.

option.name: --exit-follow-on-close
tip: During the F command on a pipe, stop waiting for more data when the writer closes the pipe.

option.name: --file-size
tip: Determine the size of the file immediately after opening it.
Lets the = command display the number of lines.

option.name: --follow-name
tip: During the F command, reopen the file by name instead of continuing to follow the original file.

option.name: --force
tip: Force non-regular files to be opened.
Also suppresses the warning shown for binary files.

option.name: --header
tip: Set the number of header lines and columns and the first header line.
Use --header=- to disable headers, equivalent to --header=0,0.

option.name: --hilite-search
tip: Highlight only the string found by the last search, not all matches.

option.name: --HILITE-SEARCH
tip: Suppress all highlighting of strings found by search commands.

option.name: --hilite-unread
tip: Highlight the first new line after a full-page forward movement.

option.name: --HILITE-UNREAD
tip: Highlight the first new line after any forward movement larger than one line.

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Ignore case in searches that do not contain uppercase letters.

option.name: --IGNORE-CASE
tip: Ignore case in all searches, even when the pattern contains uppercase letters.

option.name: --incsearch
tip: Search incrementally as each pattern character is typed.

option.name: --intr
tip: Use character C instead of ^X to interrupt a read.
C must be an ASCII character; a caret followed by a character specifies a control character.

option.name: --jump-target
tip: Screen line where the target line is positioned.
A negative number counts from the bottom; a fraction such as .5 is a share of the screen height.

option.name: --lesskey-content
tip: Interpret the text as the contents of a lesskey source file.
Lesskey lines may be separated by newlines or semicolons.

option.name: --lesskey-file
tip: Open and interpret the named file as a lesskey binary file.
Can be specified multiple times.

option.name: --lesskey-src
tip: Open and interpret the named file as a lesskey source file.

option.name: --line-num-width
tip: Minimum width of the line number field when -N is in effect. (default 7)

option.name: --line-numbers
tip: Suppress line numbers in prompts and messages.
This can speed up less when viewing very large files.

option.name: --LINE-NUMBERS
tip: Display a line number at the beginning of each line.

option.name: --log-file
tip: Copy the input to the named file as it is viewed.
Applies only to pipe input; less asks before overwriting an existing file.

option.name: --LOG-FILE
tip: Like --log-file, but overwrite an existing file without asking.

option.name: --long-prompt
tip: Prompt verbosely, with the percentage into the file.

option.name: --LONG-PROMPT
tip: Prompt even more verbosely than --long-prompt.

option.name: --match-shift
tip: Column where the first character of a search match is placed when -S shifts the screen.
A fraction such as .5 is a share of the screen width.

option.name: --max-back-scroll
tip: Maximum number of lines to scroll backward before repainting the screen.

option.name: --max-forw-scroll
tip: Maximum number of lines to scroll forward before repainting the screen.

option.name: --modelines
tip: Read N lines from the start of the file looking for vim modelines.
Use 0 to disable modeline detection.

option.name: --mouse
tip: Enable mouse input.

option.name: --MOUSE
tip: Like --mouse, but reverse the scroll direction of the mouse wheel.

option.name: --no-histdups
tip: Remove an existing entry from the history list before adding the same string again.

option.name: --no-init
tip: Don't send termcap initialization and deinitialization strings to the terminal.

option.name: --no-keypad
tip: Don't send keypad initialization and deinitialization strings to the terminal.

option.name: --no-lessopen
tip: Ignore the LESSOPEN environment variable.

option.name: --no-number-headers
tip: Don't assign line numbers to header lines.

option.name: --no-search-header-columns
tip: Searches exclude header columns but still include header lines.

option.name: --no-search-header-lines
tip: Searches exclude header lines but still include header columns.

option.name: --no-search-headers
tip: Searches exclude header lines and header columns.

option.name: --no-vbell
tip: Disable the terminal's visual bell.

option.name: --pattern
tip: Start at the first line matching PATTERN.
Equivalent to +/PATTERN.

option.name: --proc-backspace
tip: Handle backspaces as if neither -u nor -U were set.
Overrides -u and -U for backspace display.

option.name: --PROC-BACKSPACE
tip: Handle backspaces as if -U were set; treat them as control characters.

option.name: --proc-return
tip: Handle carriage returns as if neither -u nor -U were set.
Overrides -u and -U for carriage-return display.

option.name: --PROC-RETURN
tip: Handle carriage returns as if -U were set; treat them as control characters.

option.name: --proc-tab
tip: Handle tabs as if -U were not set; expand them to spaces.

option.name: --PROC-TAB
tip: Handle tabs as if -U were set; treat them as control characters.

option.name: --prompt
tip: Tailor one of the prompt styles to your own preference.
The first character selects the style: s, m, M, h, = or w.

option.name: --quit-at-eof
tip: Exit less the second time it reaches end-of-file.

option.name: --QUIT-AT-EOF
tip: Exit less the first time it reaches end-of-file.

option.name: --quit-if-one-screen
tip: Exit automatically if the entire file fits on the first screen.

option.name: --quit-on-intr
tip: Exit immediately on an interrupt character (^C) instead of returning to the prompt.

option.name: --quotes
tip: Change the filename quoting character.
One character changes the quote character; two characters change the open and close quotes.

option.name: --raw-control-chars
tip: Display control characters in raw form.
Not recommended: less can no longer track the actual appearance of the screen.

option.name: --RAW-CONTROL-CHARS
tip: Like -r, but output only ANSI color escape sequences and OSC 8 hyperlink sequences in raw form.
The screen appearance stays correct provided the file has no other escape sequences.

option.name: --redraw-on-quit
tip: Redraw the final screen after quitting.

option.name: --rscroll
tip: Character used to mark truncated lines.
May begin with a two-character attribute indicator; use - to disable the mark.

option.name: --save-marks
tip: Save marks in the history file so they persist across invocations.

option.name: --search-options
tip: Set default search modifiers.
The value is a string of one or more of E, F, K, N, R, W or a digit 1-5.
Use - to disable all default search modifiers.

option.name: --search-skip-screen
tip: Start forward searches at the bottom of the screen and backward searches at the top.

option.name: --SEARCH-SKIP-SCREEN
tip: Start every search just after or before the target line, skipping the displayed screen.

option.name: --shift
tip: Default number of positions to scroll horizontally with the arrow keys.
Zero means half the screen width; a fraction such as .5 is a share of the width.

option.name: --show-preproc-errors
tip: Display a message if a preprocessor produces data and then exits with a non-zero status.

option.name: --silent
tip: Moderately quiet operation: the bell is not rung when scrolling past either end of the file.
Other errors still ring the bell.

option.name: --SILENT
tip: Totally quiet operation: the bell is never rung.
A visual bell, if the terminal has one, is used instead.

option.name: --squeeze-blank-lines
tip: Squeeze multiple blank lines into one.

option.name: --status-col-width
tip: Width of the status column when -J is in effect. (default 2)

option.name: --status-column
tip: Display a status column at the left edge of the screen.

option.name: --status-line
tip: Highlight or color the entire line containing a mark, and lines highlighted by -w.

option.name: --tabs
tip: Set tab stops.
A single N sets stops at multiples of N; a list sets stops at those positions and continues with the last spacing.

option.name: --tag
tip: Edit the file containing TAG.

option.name: --tag-file
tip: Use the given file instead of one named tags.

option.name: --tilde
tip: Display lines after end-of-file as blank lines instead of tildes.

option.name: --underline-special
tip: Treat backspaces and carriage returns as printable characters.

option.name: --UNDERLINE-SPECIAL
tip: Treat backspaces, tabs, carriage returns and Unicode formatting characters as control characters.

option.name: --use-backslash
tip: Let a backslash in subsequent options escape the next character.

option.name: --use-color
tip: Enable colored text in various places.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the version number.

option.name: --wheel-lines
tip: Number of lines to scroll per mouse wheel click with --mouse. (default 1)

option.name: --window
tip: Default scrolling window size in lines.
The z may be omitted, as in -20; a negative number means that many lines less than the screen height.

option.name: --wordwrap
tip: Wrap lines at a space or tab if possible, so a word is not split.

option.name: -<number>
tip: Set the scrolling window size, like -z.

option.name: ++<command>
tip: Execute a less command for every file.

option.name: +<command>
tip: Execute a less command on startup.

option.name: +<number>
tip: Start at the specified line number.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display a summary of the commands accepted by less.
